lines.differs: Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: full exclusivity during the term instead of a specific regional non-compete for hospitality services.
Harsher on the vendor than CloudSpan Technologies: complete exclusivity for all services versus a narrow restriction on competing cloud platform partnerships.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: total prohibition on any outside work during the term compared to a specific travel-software restriction.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: payment is due within 60 days of timesheet approval instead of 30 days from invoice receipt.
Harsher on the vendor than Trustline NBFC: 60-day payment term following approval, compared to a shorter 45-day window from receipt.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: payment term is 60 days from approval instead of 30 days from receipt.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: AtliQ owns all IP upon creation whereas the previous vendor retained ownership and granted a license.
Harsher on the vendor than Al Noor Hospitality Group: IP vests immediately upon creation rather than waiting for full payment of fees.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: intellectual property transfers to AtliQ upon creation rather than only after full payment is received.
Harsher on the vendor than Rohan Iyer: confidentiality obligations are one-way for the vendor instead of being mutual for both parties.
Harsher on the vendor than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality is one-way with a 5-year survival, rather than mutual with a 3-year survival.
Harsher on the vendor than Trustline NBFC: confidentiality is a one-way obligation on the vendor rather than a mutual protection for both parties.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: indemnity is one-way, and AtliQ’s liability is capped at three months of fees with no vendor cap.
Harsher on the vendor than Acme Retail Group: the vendor provides a one-way indemnity, whereas the previous contract required mutual indemnification.
Harsher on the vendor than Brightwater Insurance Inc: includes a specific liability cap favoring AtliQ (3 months' fees) with no reciprocal cap for the vendor.
Harsher on the vendor than Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: disputes are settled in Pune courts instead of through arbitration in New Delhi.
Harsher on the vendor than PayTrack Technologies: mandates court litigation in Pune rather than resolving disputes through arbitration.
Fairer to the vendor than Brightwater Insurance Inc: applies local Indian law and Pune courts instead of English law and London courts.
